title: Buzzer behavioral baseline: account-window record
description: Version 1.0.0. Exactly 13 behavioral features; identity, platform, observation window and feature status are metadata. Null represents unavailable evidence, never measured zero.

account_id.description: Platform-qualified stable account ID; excluded from predictors.

window_start.description: Inclusive UTC observation cutoff, configured by the collection/modeling plan.

window_end.description: Exclusive UTC observation cutoff; must be later than window_start.

feature_status.description: One status per behavioral feature. observed requires a numeric value; every other status requires null. Validate these cross-field constraints in application code.

profile_visibility.description: Audit metadata; determined only from an explicit privacy flag.

profile_access_status.description: Latest profile check; null means not checked. Restricted means explicitly private content, even if its basic profile header is readable.

profile_checked_at.description: UTC check time; distinct from the observation time of older cached statistics.

mean_comment_length_chars.description: Mean Unicode code-point length of clean_text across sampled comments. Requires usable text extraction; an observed empty text has length zero.

mean_hashtags_per_comment.description: Mean extracted hashtag occurrences per sampled comment. No observed hashtags is zero; unavailable text/entity extraction is null.

mean_mentions_per_comment.description: Mean extracted mention occurrences per sampled comment; availability rules match hashtag counts.

mean_urls_per_comment.description: Mean extracted URL occurrences per sampled comment. Counts occurrences, not unique domains.

reply_ratio.description: Reply comments / comments with known reply status. Null when no statuses are observed; retain known-status support separately.

repeated_comment_ratio.description: Fraction of sampled comments belonging to a nonempty normalized-text group occurring at least twice for this account in the window. Includes the first copy. A,A,B gives 2/3.

shared_comment_ratio.description: Fraction of sampled comments whose normalized text occurs for another account in the permitted same-platform corpus/window and has at least 12 word characters. Text/corpus availability must be validated; generic or unshared observed text contributes zero.

comment_count.description: Number of unique sampled comments for this account in the window after snapshot deduplication. A normal account-window row requires at least one comment; null is reserved for failed/imported observations that must be quarantined before training.

source_post_count.description: Number of distinct known source videos/posts. Null when no source identities are usable; never interpret missing source IDs as zero activity. Retain source-ID completeness separately.

recurring_peer_count.description: Number of other same-platform accounts sharing at least two sampled source posts with this account. Requires at least two observed source posts and a complete permitted pair calculation; otherwise null.

max_peer_overlap_ratio.description: Maximum qualifying pair's shared-source-post count / this account's observed source-post count. Qualifying pairs share at least two posts. Zero if no pair qualifies and support/calculation are sufficient; otherwise null. This is asymmetric, not Jaccard similarity.

median_comment_interval_seconds.description: Median consecutive interval between this account's valid UTC comment timestamps in the window. Requires at least two valid timestamps; same-timestamp intervals may be observed zero.

comment_interval_burstiness.description: (sample_std(intervals)-mean(intervals))/(sample_std(intervals)+mean(intervals)), using ddof=1. Requires at least three intervals/four timestamps and a positive denominator. Zero is a measured balance, not a missing-value sentinel.
